title: Trail Journey
subtitle: From idea to production. Here's how Trail evolved over time.

items.heading: The Spark
items.description: Researching dozens of tabs, losing context between sessions, and sharing tab dumps with teammates. We knew there had to be a better way.
highlights: Identified the chaos of modern research workflows
Defined core principles: privacy-first, lightweight, shareable

items.title: Early 2024
items.heading: First Prototype
items.description: Built the initial browser extension with basic capture and tree visualization. Tested with a small group of beta users.
highlights: Basic URL capture and tree view

items.title: Mid 2024
items.heading: Sync & Share
items.description: Added cloud sync and sharing capabilities. Users could now collaborate on research paths and share insights with their teams.

items.title: Late 2024
items.heading: Polish & Scale
items.description: Refined the UI, added export options, and improved performance. Trail became production-ready for teams of all sizes.

items.heading: Public Launch
items.description: Trail is now available for everyone. We're excited to help teams organize their research and make better decisions.
